reported.how: Modal's hourly billing rows for boxrouter-internal/main App ap-lWZkAcuA3y5Tn3B2RsXP8e, proven to hold only sandbox sb-01M5NS7HS82KH89F8J5KTDEYN2.

excluded: Network egress (new): from 2026-10-01 outbound traffic is $0.04 per GiB above a workspace-wide allowance of 1 TiB per billing cycle on Starter, 10 TiB on Team, 100 TiB on Enterprise. It counts all traffic sent through a container's network interface, private network traffic sent directly to other Modal containers and uploads through Cloud Bucket Mounts; Volume reads and writes do not count. Tracked from 2026-09-01 with no charge in September; the first bill with egress is 2026-11-01. A sandbox that sends almost no traffic stays inside the allowance.
Per-creation fee: none listed on the pricing page or the Sandbox docs
Volumes: $0.09 / GiB / month, first 1 TiB / month free; recorded as volume_storage and not counted in a sandbox's cost

Sandbox snapshots: filesystem and directory snapshots expire 30 days after creation by default, and the TTL can be set per snapshot or expiry turned off; memory snapshots expire 7 days after creation and cannot currently be extended. No price stated (not included in the hourly rates here)
Plan fee: Starter $0 / month + compute; Team $250 / month + compute. The sandbox rates are the same on both.

Plan allowance: Starter: $0 / month plus compute, with $30 / month free credits, 100 containers and 3 seats; Team $250 / month with $100 / month free credits and 5000 containers; credit programs for startups and academics up to $10k (by application)
